name: Mia

description.en: A cheerful student who wants something cute.
description.vi: Sinh viên vui vẻ, muốn bộ móng dễ thương.

wants: Cute almond nails in lavender fading to white at the tips, with a few small stickers. Budget about $40.
personality: Cheerful, excited and a little shy. She loves cute designs and shows pictures on her phone. She is easy to please if the stylist is friendly.
openingLine: Hi! I saw some super cute nails online. Can you do something lavender and cute?
